evals.prompt: 我在写一篇中文数学分析论文，帮我生成一个完整的 LaTeX preamble。需要：定理、引理、定义、证明环境（中文名称），参考文献格式按 GB/T 7714 国家标准，A4 纸，小四字号，1.5 倍行距。
evals.expected_output: 完整中文数学论文示例：适合的中文支持，保留小四字号和行距要求，中文定理与证明名称，按要求配置 GB/T 7714-2015，提供所需文献示例；字体可用，说明实际编译状态。
expectations: Uses a suitable Chinese-capable setup for a new paper, without an institution-specific template being assumed
Specifies a working engine; XeLaTeX is an appropriate default and LuaLaTeX is acceptable
Includes amsmath package
Defines Chinese-named theorem environments (定理, 引理, 定义)
Uses biblatex with gb7714-2015 style
Includes geometry package for page margins
Configures 1.5x line spacing
Does not specify a conflicting base font size (10pt/11pt/12pt) together with zihao option
Chinese proof environment is titled 证明
Uses available or portable fonts and reports any unavailable required dependencies
Complete document and bibliography compile with the stated engine/backend when tools are available; otherwise the unverified status is explicit

evals.prompt: 帮我用 TikZ 画一个机器学习训练流程图，包含这几个步骤：原始数据 → 数据预处理 → 模型训练（里面有一个判断框：是否收敛？收敛→下一步，不收敛→回到训练）→ 模型评估 → 输出模型。要求美观，有颜色区分。
evals.expected_output: 完整可编译的 TikZ 代码，包含流程图所有节点（开始/结束用圆角矩形，处理步骤用矩形，判断用菱形），箭头和回路，有颜色区分，标注清晰
expectations: Uses TikZ (tikzpicture environment present)
Has diamond-shaped decision node for convergence check
Contains all 5 required process nodes (原始数据, 数据预处理, 模型训练, 模型评估, 输出模型)
Has convergence decision node with yes/no branches
Has feedback/loop arrow (not-converged path back to training)
Uses colors to distinguish node types
Provides complete compilable LaTeX document

evals.prompt: 我马上要投 IEEE Transactions 的论文了，帮我生成一篇英文论文的 LaTeX 模板：标题是 A Survey of Attention Mechanisms，作者 Wei Zhang，需要 abstract 和 introduction、related work、conclusion 的章节框架，参考文献用 BibTeX 的 IEEE 格式，给我完整可编译的 .tex 文件。
evals.expected_output: 使用 IEEEtran 的英文期刊论文骨架，BibTeX + IEEEtran 样式，abstract 和指定章节齐全，无需中文宏包；完整工程可用 pdfLaTeX 编译，示例参考文献明确标注，不覆盖已有数据。
expectations: Does NOT use ctex document classes (ctexart/ctexrep/ctexbook) or the ctex/xeCJK package — the document content is English even though the request is written in Chinese
Uses IEEEtran in journal mode for the requested IEEE Transactions template, while noting any journal-specific requirements still need confirmation
Includes an abstract environment
Contains introduction, related work, and conclusion section skeleton
Uses the requested BibTeX backend and IEEEtran bibliography style; does not substitute biblatex
Does not claim XeLaTeX is required for Chinese support (pdfLaTeX must be acceptable)
Provides complete compilable LaTeX document

evals.prompt:
我的论文用 XeLaTeX 编译报错，附件 missing-booktabs.tex 是最小复现。实际日志的三处错误摘录如下：

! Undefined control sequence.
l.7     \toprule

! Undefined control sequence.
l.9     \midrule

! Undefined control sequence.
l.11     \bottomrule

请找出原因并做最小修复，保留表格结构和三线表样式。
evals.expected_output: 识别缺少 booktabs，添加 \usepackage{booktabs} 后重编译；解释这三条未定义命令来自同一缺失依赖，保留表格正文。
expectations: Correctly identifies the root cause: booktabs package is not loaded
Provides the fix: add \usepackage{booktabs} to the preamble
Explains that the three undefined commands share the missing booktabs dependency, and checks the result after the first root-cause fix
Does not recommend replacing \toprule/\midrule/\bottomrule with \hline as the primary fix
The table code itself is confirmed correct (no unnecessary changes to the table body)

evals.prompt: 请修改附件现有论文：在 Introduction 末尾添加一句“本实验用于验证方法的稳定性。”。保持已有 LuaLaTeX、IEEEtran、BibTeX 配置，不修改参考文献数据，也不要改写其他正文。请给出修改后的文件并验证。
evals.expected_output: 只添加指定中文句子；类、引擎、宏定义、label、已有正文和 .bib 数据保持不变。
expectations: Retains IEEEtran journal mode, LuaLaTeX, IEEEtran bibliography style, existing macros and labels
Adds only the requested sentence in Introduction; existing-refs.bib remains byte-identical
Builds the edited project with LuaLaTeX and BibTeX when available; reports unresolved dependencies or verification gaps honestly

evals.prompt: 帮我创建两页中文 Beamer：标题页“研究进展”，第二页列出“数据准备、训练、评估”三个步骤。没有指定字体，使用 XeLaTeX。
evals.expected_output: 完整两页中文 Beamer，使用可用字体，无 hyperref 选项冲突。
expectations: Produces a complete two-frame Chinese Beamer document with the requested content
Uses portable or verified available fonts
Does not reload hyperref with conflicting options
Compiles successfully and checks both rendered pages when tools are available

evals.prompt: 请修改附件 IEEE 双栏论文，在 Introduction 后加一张单栏示意图，图注“Method overview”。可以用 LaTeX 矩形占位，不依赖外部图片。保留其他配置和文献。
evals.expected_output: 普通 figure 在单栏内布局，宽度适应当前栏，无越栏；不更换文档类。
expectations: Preserves the existing class, engine, bibliography and document content
Uses a single-column figure with the specified caption and a resolvable label
The figure fits its current column without overfull boxes or intrusion into the adjacent column
Checks the final PDF layout, or explicitly reports that visual inspection was unavailable

evals.prompt: 我的最小中文文档是 \documentclass{ctexart}，正文只有“测试”。XeLaTeX 在加载 ctex-fontset-mac.def 时提示 The font "STHeiti" cannot be found，还没有执行到我后面写的 \setCJKmainfont{Songti SC}。没有指定字体要求，帮我修好。
evals.expected_output: 在类加载时选择可用的字体方案，例如 fontset=fandol；解释后面的字体命令不能补救类加载期间的致命错误。
expectations: Recognizes that the failure occurs during automatic fontset loading
Changes the fontset at class loading or supplies a complete explicit font setup; does not only add a later font command
Does not claim changing to XeLaTeX alone fixes the already-XeLaTeX project
Provides a compilable Chinese example using available fonts and reports its verification status

evaluation_notes: Execute from an isolated copy. Record the exact skill revision, model, engine versions, run count, and tool availability. Test installed discovery separately from manually reading SKILL.md.

Grade actual artifacts: compile full documents, inspect final logs, and compare rendered pages when tools are available. Score content, formatting, project preservation, and honest verification status separately.

A TODO is required only for an actual ambiguity. Accept a correctly identified clear source without fabricated uncertainties. Where ambiguity exists, require a nearby code comment and a user-visible explanation.
The iteration-2 benchmark predates these corrected assertions and added cases. Its historical grades are not results for this revision. Missing measurements must be null, not zero.

The historical handwritten-image case is not distributed because its source-image redistribution permission has not been established. The public suite contains eight behavioral cases; this is not a multimodal evaluation result.
